headline: WHITE CLIFF EXTENDS RAE COPPER DISCOVERY: 76.5M @ 2.01% CU AT DANVERS 1 — HANCOCK PROSPECTING HOLDS 13.5% STAKE
snippet: White Cliff Minerals (ASX: WCN) reported a new hole at Danvers 1, Rae Copper project in Nunavut, returning 76.5 metres grading 2.01% copper and 5.72 g/t silver — adding to a growing system where earlier diamond holes hit 50.9m at 2.81% Cu. Strategic backer Hancock Prospecting holds a 13.5% stake following a September private placement; the company is fast-tracking toward an Exploration Target and Maiden Resource Estimate across the Danvers 1, 2 and 3 targets.

headline: MIDAS MINERALS HITS 11.55% COPPER EQUIVALENT OVER 10M AT T-13, NAMIBIA — RESOURCE ESTIMATE DUE Q1 2027
snippet: Midas Minerals (ASX: MM1) reported infill drilling at its T-13 Copper-Silver Deposit in Namibia returning 22.6 metres at 6.01% copper equivalent, including a 10.0-metre high-grade core at 11.55% CuEq — building on a string of high-grade hits that include 30.1m at 5.35% CuEq. With up to 15 drill rigs on site and a Q1 2027 updated resource estimate targeted, T-13 is positioning as one of the higher-grade copper sulphide discoveries in southern Africa.

headline: MONTANA COPPER-GOLD INTERCEPT: AMERICAN PACIFIC HITS 7.40 G/T AU OVER 30.8M AT MADISON, STEP-OUT SURVEYS NEXT
snippet: American Pacific Mining (OTC: USGDF) is planning downhole electromagnetic surveys to guide step-out drilling at its Madison Copper-Gold Project in Montana, following a 30.8-metre massive sulphide intersection averaging 7.40 g/t gold, 9.62 g/t silver and 0.29% copper. The 3D modelling from downhole surveys will vector follow-up holes into what the company believes is a larger sulphide envelope, with results expected before year-end.

headline: MP MATERIALS TO DELIVER GM'S FIRST NON-CHINA RARE EARTH MAGNETS THIS QUARTER — PENTAGON HOLDS $400M STAKE
snippet: MP Materials (NYSE: MP) is on track to ship its first commercial rare earth permanent magnets to General Motors in Q4 2026 — the first such delivery outside Chinese supply chains — as the U.S. Defense Department's $400 million preferred equity stake turns production-backed. The Fort Worth magnet factory is tripling capacity for GM and Apple; a separate 10,000-tonne per year Pentagon-dedicated '10X Facility' begins commissioning in 2028.

headline: CAULDRON ENERGY DRILLS 100 HOLES AT YANREY URANIUM AT NEAR-100% HIT RATE — WA MINING BAN UNDER PARLIAMENTARY REVIEW
snippet: Cauldron Energy (ASX: CXU) has completed 100 aircore holes totalling 10,506 metres at its Yanrey Project in Western Australia with a near-100% drilling success rate, extending uranium mineralisation at Manyingee North by 2.5km and at Manyingee South by 2,500 metres beyond the current resource polygon — pushing the total resource toward a combined resource base exceeding 55 million pounds U3O8. A WA Parliamentary Inquiry examining the state's longstanding uranium mining ban could remove the single regulatory constraint blocking the asset.

headline: LI-FT POWER LAUNCHES 45,000M DRILL PROGRAM AT YELLOWKNIFE LITHIUM — CANADA'S LARGEST SINGLE-SEASON SPODUMENE CAMPAIGN
snippet: Li-FT Power (TSX-V: LIFT) has launched a 45,000-metre drill program at its Yellowknife Lithium Project in Canada's Northwest Territories — the largest single-season spodumene drilling campaign in Canadian history — targeting deep extensions of the BIG East pegmatite where earlier holes returned 26m at 1.29% Li2O from surface. A preliminary economic assessment is targeted for 2027, building on confirmed high-grade continuity across the 26-pegmatite Yellowknife system.

headline: HOCHSCHILD KEEPS 2026 GOLD OUTPUT GUIDANCE DESPITE COST CREEP — BERENBERG LIFTS TARGET AS MARGINS STAY ELEVATED
snippet: Hochschild Mining (LSE: HOC) reaffirmed its 2026 production guidance of 300,000–328,000 gold equivalent ounces despite all-in sustaining costs running 5–10% above the guided range due to escalating royalties, profit-sharing and currency movements across Peru, Brazil and Argentina operations. Berenberg raised its price target following a steady Q3 from Inmaculada, which is on track for 199,000–209,000 oz annually at current gold prices above $4,100/oz.

headline: JUNIORS STUCK AT 0.51X P/NAV DESPITE RECORD MARGINS — THE M&A RESET THAT MUST COME
snippet: With senior gold miners averaging 0.75x P/NAV and juniors at 0.51x despite the highest sector margins in a generation, Skillings Mining Intelligence traces the structural M&A discount to institutional under-positioning — arguing that 2026's unusually dense feasibility study and resource estimate calendar is the trigger that should reset junior valuations as producers flush with cash replace depleting reserve bases.

headline: CENTRAL BANKS BOUGHT 474 TONNES OF GOLD IN Q1 2026 — SO WHY ARE MINING STOCKS AMPLIFYING THE METAL'S LOSSES?
snippet: An October 2026 analysis examines the growing disconnect between record central bank gold accumulation and the underperformance of gold mining equities — with Sibanye-Stillwater down 7.92% and Equinox Gold falling nearly 38% year-to-date while spot gold declined just 7.2%. The piece identifies royalty escalation, cost inflation and a structural 'mining risk premium' as reasons the equities are failing to track the bullion price even at decade-high operating margins.

headline: ENERGY STORAGE SURGE REBUILDS LITHIUM DEMAND FLOOR: GRID-SCALE BATTERIES UP 150% IN NORTH AMERICA, AI DATA CENTRES ADD PRICE-INSENSITIVE BID
snippet: Stationary energy storage has overtaken passenger EVs as the fastest-growing lithium demand segment, with grid-scale battery installations jumping 150% year-on-year in North America and AI data-centre UPS conversions from lead-acid to lithium-ion adding a new price-insensitive demand floor. Analysts now see a structural deficit in spodumene concentrate tightening into 2027 as Chinese inventory drawdowns converge with the storage and data-centre surge.

headline: ARGENTINA'S $40B COPPER BOOM IN LEGAL JEOPARDY: GLENCORE, BHP, FIRST QUANTUM AWAIT GLACIER LAW COURT VERDICT
snippet: Argentina's amended glacier protection law — which unlocked Milei's $40+ billion copper investment pipeline from Glencore, BHP, First Quantum and Lundin Mining — faces continuing constitutional challenges before provincial and national courts, with Greenpeace's collective lawsuit the most advanced remaining threat to projects including BHP's $18B Vicuña joint venture in San Juan province. The investment case for Argentine copper juniors hinges on which court rules first.

headline: SUMITOMO: NICKEL SURPLUS HOLDS AT 256,000 TONNES INTO 2027 AS INDONESIA OUTPUT RISES AGAIN — BATTERY DEMAND STILL TOO SLOW TO ABSORB
snippet: Sumitomo Metal Mining forecasts a 256,000-tonne nickel surplus in 2026 persisting into 2027 as Indonesian nickel pig iron output rises 4.1% to 1.76 million tonnes — further suppressing junior nickel developer valuations while reinforcing copper and lithium as the 'deficit metals' of the current energy transition cycle. Battery demand growth is projected at low single-digits, insufficient to absorb Indonesia's continued ramp-up.
